name: Softtemplates For Elementor
author: SoftHopper

sections.description:
The special features of elementor which helps you to build your post template and have ability to create most attractive layouts.

Features

  1. Header Footer builder
  2. Single Post builder
  3. Archive Page builder
  4. Page Template builder
  5. Conditional Template View
  6. Conditional Logics.
  7. AI / MCP support (WordPress Abilities API)
  8. And much more

Widget Include

We include widget that you can build your pages

  • Archive Description. Add Archive Description in your archive pages.
  • Archive & Post Title. Add Archive or Post Title in your archive and post page.
  • Breadcrumbs. Add Breadcrumbs into your pages.
  • Featured Images. Add featured image at your single post pages.
  • Logo. Add logo into your header.
  • Menu. Add menu into your header.
  • Off Canvas. Add offcanvas into your header.
  • Advance Query Posts. Add Advance Query Posts into your archive post and other pages too.
  • Post Author Box. Add post Author box into your single post page to display author.
  • Post Comment. Add post comment into your post page.
  • Post Content. Add post content into your post page.
  • Post Excerpt. Add post excerpt into your post page.
  • Post Meta. Add post meta into your post page.
  • Post Navigation. Add post navigation into your post page.
  • Post Title. Add post title into your post page.
  • Seach. Add search into your site header.
  • Post Share. Add post share into your post page.
  • Mini Cart(WooCommerce). Add Mini cart in your site header.
  • Site Title & Tagline. Show the site name and tagline in your header.
  • Copyright. Footer copyright line with an automatic year.
  • Back to Top. Floating or inline button that scrolls back to the top.
  • Reading Progress Bar. Shows how far visitors have read.
  • Table of Contents. Builds a linked list of the post’s headings.

Free Dynamic Tags

Fill any Elementor field with live data: post title, excerpt, date, terms, custom field, comments, reading time, featured image, archive title and description, author name, bio, URL and avatar, site title, tagline, URL, logo and the current date.

Display Conditions

Show templates on the entire site, front page, posts, pages, categories, tags, custom taxonomies, the blog page, author and date archives, search results or 404, with exceptions (exclude locations or specific pages) and logged-in / logged-out targeting.

AI & MCP Support

SoftTemplates registers its tools with the WordPress Abilities API and adds them to Elementor’s MCP server, so AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients) can manage your theme builder for you:

  • Get a site overview and list or read templates.
  • Create header, footer, single, archive, page and section templates.
  • List and import ready-made template presets.
  • List and set display conditions.
  • List, add, update and remove widgets, and update template settings.

Requires a WordPress version with the Abilities API (6.9+) and Elementor’s MCP server. Tools follow Elementor’s MCP on/off setting and can be turned off with the soft-template-core/mcp/public filter.

Header/Footer Options Include

  • Sticky Header. Add sticky header into your site.
  • Fixed Header. Add fixed or transparent header into your site.
  • Fixed Footer. Add fixed footer into your sites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload “softtemplates-for-elementor For Elementor” folder to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Security: Fixed stored XSS in the Post Archive “Read More” button (button text, CSS classes and link are now escaped).
  • Security: Fixed stored XSS in the Post Navigation arrow icon class.
  • Security: Post Archive and preview requests now sanitize post ID, page number and term ID input.
  • Performance: Social Share counts are now cached (6 hours) and use a 3-second timeout instead of calling external APIs with a 30-second timeout on every page view.
  • Performance: Editor post/page search is limited to 50 results instead of loading all posts.
  • Performance: Removed a duplicate user query in the Post Archive author list.
  • Performance: Dashboard overview loads template data in one query instead of one per template.
  • Fix: Post Archive no longer prints PHP code as text above posts when the date or featured image is shown.
  • Fix: Post Archive no longer crashes on PHP 8 when an invalid page number is requested.
  • Fix: Off-Canvas no longer shows an “Undefined array key offcanvas_width” warning.
  • Fix: Off-Canvas no longer shows a warning when the browser sends no user agent.

1.1.0

  • Compatibility: Elementor 4.x and WordPress 7.x.
  • Compatibility: Use elementor/widgets/register and elementor/controls/register hooks (removes Elementor deprecation notices).
  • Compatibility: Removed calls to APIs removed from Elementor (Post_CSS_File, Utils::get_edit_link).
  • Compatibility: Plugin now requires Elementor 3.5+ and shows an admin notice instead of a fatal error when Elementor is missing.
  • Security: Added nonce verification to all AJAX endpoints, template creation and settings save.
  • Security: Settings input is now sanitized and restricted.
  • Security: Validated user-selectable HTML tags and escaped widget output to prevent stored XSS.
  • Security: Enabled SSL verification for remote template requests.
  • Security: Added direct-access guards to all PHP files.
  • Fix: Template library import and “clone template” were broken by incorrect input sanitization.
  • Fix: Mini cart total no longer drops decimals.
  • Fix: Plugin asset version now matches plugin version (cache busting).
  • New: React admin dashboard (Dashboard, Templates, Widgets, Settings, Help).
  • New: Site Title & Tagline, Copyright, Back to Top, Reading Progress Bar and Table of Contents widgets.
  • New: 20 free dynamic tags (registered when Elementor Pro is not active).
  • New: Display conditions for the blog page, author archives and date archives.
  • New: Exceptions for display conditions (exclude locations or specific pages) and logged-in / logged-out targeting.
  • New: Post Meta items “Last Updated” and “Reading Time”.
  • New: Search form on empty search results in Advance Query Posts.
  • Fix: Widgets added in an update are no longer hidden for sites that saved widget settings before.
  • New: 11 SoftTemplates abilities (WordPress Abilities API) on Elementor’s MCP server: overview, list/get/create templates, list conditions, set conditions, list widgets, add/update/remove widgets, update settings.
  • New: Template library with 6 starter presets (2 headers, 2 footers, single post, blog archive), an optional online library (e.g. a GitHub repository) and a Presets tab in the editor library.
  • New: Import templates from .json files (SoftTemplates or Elementor exports) and export any template as .json.
  • New: MCP tools list-presets and import-preset.
  • Fix: The template-type tabs in the editor library failed to load (missing API object).
  • Fix: “Clone to Library” saved template content in the wrong format.
  • Fix: Archive Title, Archive Description and Post Comment widgets broke the global post on empty archives and search results.
  • Fix: Nav Menu widget warning when no menu is selected; it now falls back to the first menu.
  • Fix: The SoftTemplates Library button in the Elementor editor is now a visible round button next to Elementor’s + and folder buttons, appears in every add-section area, and opens on the Presets tab.
  • Fix: The SoftTemplates Library popup now follows the Elementor editor’s light or dark UI theme, and preset cards always show their titles.

screenshots.caption: Dashboard: see which headers, footers, single and archive templates are active, and your setup progress.
Templates: create a template, see where each one is shown and edit it with Elementor.
Template library: import ready-made header, footer, single post and archive presets.
Widgets: turn individual widgets on or off to keep the Elementor panel tidy.
Settings: choose how SoftTemplates works alongside Elementor Pro locations.
Build templates in the Elementor editor with the Soft Templates widgets, such as Breadcrumbs, Post Title, Post Meta and Featured Image.
